the control for the case above, and the reason `plan` is not simply removed from PATCHABLE_SECTIONS. A guard that refused the whole section would take a legitimate change with the illegitimate one.

the control for the two above: the half of `ai` 6.2 added it for. Which sections carry a paragraph is exactly the configuration judgement the planner exists to make, and it was refused outright before the section was admitted.
